stem: Let $X=\{x\in\mathbb{Z} : -{=p}\le x\le {=q}\}$, so $X$ is a set of integers. The product $X\times X$ is drawn as points on a perpendicular graphical net. How many of the points of $X\times X$ lie on the axes (that is, have $x=0$ or $y=0$)?
solution: X has {=p + q + 1} elements: the integers from -{=p} to {=q}, including 0.
Points on the x-axis have y = 0 and any x in X: {=p + q + 1} points. Points on the y-axis have x = 0 and any y in X: {=p + q + 1} points.
The point (0, 0) is counted twice, so the total is {=p + q + 1} + {=p + q + 1} - 1 = {=2 * (p + q) + 1}.
notes: X is explicitly integers so the count is finite. Answer 2(p+q)+1.
